about_the_game:
In this Demo:
Defend your village against oncoming waves of Ogres using your crossbow and the power of the ancient Ogrewatch Tower. Collect loot from your slain enemies and decide to sell or scrap it based on how you want to play the game. Discover hidden passages and delve under the tower to find more powerful upgrades. Use collected Ogre Souls to further upgrade your crossbow or to power up the tower. 

A successful run of the demo will take less than an hour of gameplay, but most players will find it difficult to complete the demo without failing several times first.

This demo shows the beginning of the game in a limited form and with an ending designed for the demo only. It is intended to give players a limited picture of the full game, but does not contain every system included in the full game. The full game will contain additional upgrade trees, mechanics, explorable areas, and story elements that are not implemented in the demo.

--- Game Info ---
Ogrewatch is a first-person tower defense game where you play as the lone defender against the oncoming Ogre horde that threatens to destroy your people. Grab your crossbow and take up the mantle of the famed Ogrewatch as you secure the ancient tower in the woods and prevent the Ogres from reaching your village.

Upgrade your weapon

As you kill ogres you'll be able to select from various upgrades to improve your crossbow. Choose wisely to keep up with the ever-massing waves of attackers.

Awaken Ancient Power

Uncover the tower's secrets to unlock its hidden power and keep the ogres at bay. Delve into the depths to gain ancient power while always keeping an eye out for Ogres on the Horizon.

Build up your defenses

Use your collected gold to hire guards to bolster your defenses.
